challenge.title: A Visit to the Doctor and the Pharmacy
challenge.instructions: Write and act out a conversation of at least 10 lines where you tell a friend or a doctor how you feel, describe at least two symptoms using body-part words, and then go to the pharmacy to get medicine. Use at least 8 target phrases from Unit 9 and include both a masculine-address and a feminine-address form somewhere in your conversation.
required_elements: A question about how someone feels, like كيداير or شنو وقع ليك.
At least two symptoms named with body-part words, such as راسي or كرشي.
A mention of السخانة or الصداع or another specific complaint.
A question asking since when the person has felt this way, using من وقتاش.
A pharmacy or doctor request using عندك or بغيت.
A question about a prescription using الوصفة.
Instructions for taking medicine, such as جوج مرات فالنهار.
A closing wish using الله يشافيك and its reply الله يبارك فيك.
